nodes.name: Onboarding.jsx
nodes.summary: Responsive router for the CV6 first-run onboarding flow; mounts OnboardingDesktop or OnboardingMobile based on a viewport media query.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the app-wide 900px breakpoint (below 900 = mobile layout) via the useMediaQuery hook.

nodes.name: OnboardingDesktop.jsx
nodes.summary: Desktop onboarding screen that composes the wired HTML template with loading/error/empty states and binds real onboarding data plus step-progression actions via TemplateScreen.
nodes.languageNotes: Precomputes screen HTML at module load with DOMParser, injecting shared state blocks from states-extra.html.

nodes.name: OnboardingMobile.jsx
nodes.summary: Mobile onboarding screen that mounts the full-width onboarding template with a step indicator and binds real data plus back/skip/next progression via TemplateScreen.
nodes.languageNotes: Mirrors OnboardingDesktop's compose-and-bind pattern against the onboarding-mobile screen variant.

nodes.name: useOnboarding.js
nodes.summary: React hook backing the guided first-run onboarding flow: tracks auth, step index, and theme, and shapes the step/connection/agent/theme view model consumed by the desktop and mobile screens.
nodes.languageNotes: Theme selection is real (localStorage + Supabase auth), while connections, agent permissions, and goal creation are honest HELD-C placeholders shown as not-connected/off rather than faked.

nodes.name: Onboarding
nodes.summary: Default-exported component that reads the mobile media query and renders either OnboardingMobile or OnboardingDesktop, forwarding onNav and onOpenNav props.

nodes.name: composeOnboardingDesktop
nodes.summary: Parses the onboarding template, selects the named desktop screen, and appends shared loading/error/empty state blocks, returning the composed screen outerHTML.

nodes.name: OnboardingDesktop
nodes.summary: Default-exported desktop onboarding component that pulls onboarding state/data from useOnboarding and wires back/skip/next/theme actions into TemplateScreen, advancing to Home on the final step.

nodes.name: composeOnboardingMobile
nodes.summary: Parses the onboarding template, selects the named mobile screen, and appends shared loading/error/empty state blocks, returning the composed screen outerHTML.

nodes.name: OnboardingMobile
nodes.summary: Default-exported mobile onboarding component that pulls onboarding state/data from useOnboarding and wires back/skip/next/theme actions into TemplateScreen, advancing to Home on the final step.

nodes.name: useOnboarding
nodes.summary: Onboarding hook that watches Supabase auth, persists/reads theme from localStorage, tracks the step index, and memoizes the full view model (lead rail, progress dots, current step, connections, agents, themes) for the onboarding screens.
